crossRefs.note: and it went down westward to the border of the Japhletites, to the border of Beth Horon the lower, and on to Gezer; and…
This was the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families. The border of their inheritance eastward…
His daughter was Sheerah, who built Beth Horon the lower and the upper, and Uzzen Sheerah.

parallels.note: Solomon built in the land Gezer, Beth Horon the lower,

people.name: Beth-horon_Lower
people.line: Town in Ephraim and Dan, site of a famous battle.

people.name: Beth-horon_Upper
people.line: Town in Ephraim, near Lower Beth-horon.

translations.web: Also he built Beth Horon the upper and Beth Horon the lower, fortified cities, with walls, gates, and bars;
translations.bsb: He rebuilt Upper and Lower Beth-horon as fortified cities with walls, gates, and bars,
translations.kjv: Also he built Bethhoron the upper, and Bethhoron the nether, fenced cities, with walls, gates, and bars;
translations.asv: Also he built Beth-horon the upper, and Beth-horon the nether, fortified cities, with walls, gates, and bars;
